description: This file defines an authentication context provider and hooks for managing user authentication state within a React application, utilizing Supabase for backend auth functionalities. It manages session state, provides login via email and Google, and exposes user info and auth status.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React functional component providing auth context to its children.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook for consuming the auth context.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Custom hook returning current user role from session data.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth
methods.description: Alias hook for useAuth, provided for backward compatibility.
